## Review
This is a reality show where Park Bo-gum holds a barber's license and opens a hair salon in a rural village.  
Since he is with his close friends Lee Sang-yi and Kwak Dong-yeon, their chemistry is natural and not forced.  
Listening to the stories of the elderly while trimming their hair is all there is to this program.  

The review that it gives <mark>harmless fun without sensational editing or forced high-tension</mark> was absolutely spot on.  
It's just a hair salon newly opened in the countryside, but watching it makes one's heart soften.  
```adcard
```
It was heartwarming to see them trimming hair and even serving a warm meal.  
The rustic dialect and laughter felt as if they were being transmitted right out of the screen.  

I've always liked this kind of healing content.  
Watching reality shows that flow calmly without any major incidents makes me feel like the fatigue of the day is melting away.  

`Bogum Magical` was a program that filled exactly that kind of healing.  
It was heartwarming all the way through, and it made my heart feel warm.  

Since Season 2 is coming in the second half of the year, I'm already looking forward to it.
